```{r}

ctd <- read_csv(here("files", "ctd_kc10_fzh01_2025-08-09.csv"))
```

```{r}
#Daily average of wind and wind direction with 3 day backwards average
wind_dm <- wind %>% 
  mutate(date_time = mdy_hm(measurementTime),
         date = date(date_time)) %>%
  filter(WindSpd_UQL == 2) %>%
  filter(WindDir_UQL == 2) %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% 
  summarise(w_dm = mean(WindSpd_Avg),
            wd_dm = mean(WindDir_Avg)) %>% 
  mutate(wind_b1_3 = rollmeanr(lag(w_dm, 1), k = 3, fill = NA),
            wd_b1_3 = rollmeanr(lag(wd_dm, 1), k = 3, fill = NA)) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#Daily average of freshwater discharge with 10 day backward averages
fw_m <- fw %>% 
  filter(Watershed_group %in% c("Q_GM", "Q_SM")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Watershed_group, values_from = Q) %>% 
  mutate(date = date(Date)) %>% 
  select(-Date) %>% 
  mutate(qgm_10 = rollmeanr(lag(Q_GM, 1), k = 10, fill = NA),
         qsm_10 = rollmeanr(lag(Q_SM, 1), k = 10, fill = NA)) 
```

```{r}
#Join the daily averaged weather data
weather_join <- wind_dm %>% 
  left_join(fw_m)
```


```{r}
ctd_calc <- ctd %>% 
  mutate(date = date(`Measurement time`)) %>%
  filter(`Cast Direction Flag` == "d") %>% 
  # filter(is.na(`Fluorometry Chlorophyll flag`)) %>% 
  select(castpk = `Cast PK`,
         ctd_num =`CTD serial number`,
         date, m_time = `Measurement time`,
         station = Station,
         longitude = `Station Longitude`,
         latitude = `Station Latitude`,
         pres = `Pressure (dbar)`,
         sal = `Salinity (PSU)`,
         temp = `Temperature (deg C)`) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate absolute salinity from practical salinity
    sa = gsw_SA_from_SP(sal, pres, longitude, latitude),  # Adjust lat/lon for your study area
    # Calculate conservative temperature from in-situ temperature
    ct = gsw_CT_from_t(sa, temp, pres),
    # Calculate in-situ density (kg/m³)
    density = gsw_rho(sa, ct, pres),
    # Calculate potential density anomaly (sigma-theta, kg/m³ - 1000)
    sigma_theta = gsw_sigma0(sa, ct)
  )


ctd_stratification <- ctd_calc %>%
  group_by(castpk) %>%
  arrange(castpk, pres) %>%
  filter(pres >= 2 & pres <= 30) %>%
  
  mutate(
    # Manual density gradient (keep for reference)
    delta_sigma = c(NA, diff(sigma_theta)),
    delta_pres = c(NA, diff(pres)),
    d_sigma_dz = delta_sigma / delta_pres
  ) %>%
  
  summarise(
    date = first(date),
    station = first(station),
    latitude = first(latitude),
    longitude = first(longitude),
    
    # Manual metrics (keep these - they're useful)
    mean_density_gradient = mean(d_sigma_dz, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_density_gradient = max(d_sigma_dz, na.rm = TRUE),
    pycnocline_depth_manual = pres[which.max(d_sigma_dz)],
    
    # Density difference (2m - 30m)
    sigma_2m = sigma_theta[which.min(abs(pres - 2))],
    sigma_30m = sigma_theta[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    delta_sigma_2_30 = sigma_30m - sigma_2m,
    stratification_index = delta_sigma_2_30 / 28,
    
    # PROPER N² using gsw (use this for RDA)
    N2_gsw = list(gsw_Nsquared(
      SA = sa,
      CT = ct,
      p = pres,
      lat = first(latitude)
    )),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  # Extract gsw N² metrics
  mutate(
    mean_N2 = map_dbl(N2_gsw, ~mean(.x$N2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_N2 = map_dbl(N2_gsw, ~max(.x$N2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_N = sqrt(abs(mean_N2)),  # BV frequency (rad/s)
    pycnocline_depth = map_dbl(N2_gsw, ~{
      if(length(.x$N2) > 0 && !all(is.na(.x$N2))) {
        .x$p_mid[which.max(.x$N2)]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-N2_gsw)  # Remove list column
```

```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Join CTD profiles with stratification metrics, then daily average
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Step 1: Join the two dataframes by castpk
ctd_combined <- ctd_calc %>%
  left_join(
    ctd_stratification %>% select(castpk, mean_N2, max_N2, mean_N, 
                                   pycnocline_depth, delta_sigma_2_30, 
                                   stratification_index),
    by = "castpk"
  )

# Step 2: Daily average by date, station, and pressure
ctd_daily <- ctd_combined %>%
  # Round pressure to nearest integer to group similar depths
  mutate(pres_bin = round(pres, 0)) %>%
  
  # Group by date, station, and pressure bin
  group_by(date, station, pres_bin) %>%
  
  # Calculate daily averages for all variables
  summarise(
    # Location (take first/mean)
    latitude = mean(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    longitude = mean(longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Number of casts averaged
    n_casts = n_distinct(castpk),
    
    # CTD variables
    pres = mean(pres, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    sal = mean(sal, na.rm = TRUE),
    sa = mean(sa, na.rm = TRUE),
    ct = mean(ct, na.rm = TRUE),
    density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    sigma_theta = mean(sigma_theta, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Stratification metrics (same for all depths in a cast)
    mean_N2 = mean(mean_N2, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_N2 = mean(max_N2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_N = mean(mean_N, na.rm = TRUE),
    pycnocline_depth = mean(pycnocline_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_sigma_2_30 = mean(delta_sigma_2_30, na.rm = TRUE),
    stratification_index = mean(stratification_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  
  # Rename pres_bin back to pres for clarity
  rename(pres_original = pres) %>%
  rename(pres = pres_bin) %>%
  
  # Sort for clean profiles
  arrange(date, station, pres)
```

```{r}
#Selecting 5m depth nutrients for QU39.
n <- n %>%
  select(date,
         pres = line_out_depth,
         no2 = no2_no3_um,
         sio2 = sio2,
         po4 = po4) %>%
  drop_na()

#Calculating daily mean in situation where there are duplicates.
n_dm <- n %>%
  group_by(date, pres) %>%
  summarise(no2_dm = mean(no2),
            po4_dm = mean(po4),
            sio2_dm = mean(sio2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(pres = case_when(pres == 0 ~ 1,
                          T ~ as.numeric(pres)))
```

```{r}
ctd_daily <- ctd_daily %>% 
  left_join(n_dm) 
```
```{r}
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract 5m and 30m values separately
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ctd_daily_layers <- ctd_daily %>%
  group_by(date, station) %>%
  summarise(
        # ===== 1M LAYER (surface, where phytoplankton are) =====
    temp_1m = temp[which.min(abs(pres - 1))],
    sal_1m = sal[which.min(abs(pres - 1))],
    sigma_1m = sigma_theta[which.min(abs(pres - 1))],
    density_1m = density[which.min(abs(pres - 1))],
    # Add nutrients when you have them:
    nitrate_1m = no2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 1))],
    phosphate_1m = po4_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 1))],
    silicate_1m = sio2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 1))],
    
    # ===== 5M LAYER (surface, where phytoplankton are) =====
    temp_5m = temp[which.min(abs(pres - 5))],
    sal_5m = sal[which.min(abs(pres - 5))],
    sigma_5m = sigma_theta[which.min(abs(pres - 5))],
    density_5m = density[which.min(abs(pres - 5))],
    # Add nutrients when you have them:
    nitrate_5m = no2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 5))],
    phosphate_5m = po4_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 5))],
    silicate_5m = sio2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 5))],
    
            # ===== 10M LAYER (surface, where phytoplankton are) =====
    temp_10m = temp[which.min(abs(pres - 10))],
    sal_10m = sal[which.min(abs(pres - 10))],
    sigma_10m = sigma_theta[which.min(abs(pres - 10))],
    density_10m = density[which.min(abs(pres - 10))],
    # Add nutrients when you have them:
    nitrate_10m = no2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 10))],
    phosphate_10m = po4_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 10))],
    silicate_10m = sio2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 10))],
    
    # ===== 30M LAYER (below pycnocline, deep reservoir) =====
    temp_30m = temp[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    sal_30m = sal[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    sigma_30m = sigma_theta[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    density_30m = density[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    nitrate_30m = no2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    phosphate_30m = po4_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    silicate_30m = sio2_dm[which.min(abs(pres - 30))],
    
    # ===== WATER COLUMN STRATIFICATION (2-30m) =====
    mean_N2 = first(mean_N2),
    pycnocline_depth = first(pycnocline_depth),
    delta_sigma_2_30 = first(delta_sigma_2_30),
    stratification_index = first(stratification_index),
    
    # ===== DERIVED METRICS =====
    # Temperature difference (proxy for stratification)
    delta_temp_5_30 = temp_5m - temp_30m,
    
    # Density difference (already have this as delta_sigma_2_30, but more precise)
    delta_sigma_5_30 = sigma_30m - sigma_5m,
    
    # When you add nutrients, calculate gradients:
    # Nutrient gradients
    delta_nitrate_5_30 = nitrate_30m - nitrate_5m,
    delta_phosphate_5_30 = phosphate_30m - phosphate_5m,
    delta_silicate_5_30 = silicate_30m - silicate_5m,
#     
#     # N:P ratios at each depth
    NP_ratio_5m = nitrate_5m / (phosphate_5m + 0.01),
    NP_ratio_30m = nitrate_30m / (phosphate_30m + 0.01),
#     
#     # Si:N ratios (diatom growth index)
    SiN_ratio_5m = silicate_5m / (nitrate_5m + 0.01),
    SiN_ratio_30m = silicate_30m / (nitrate_30m + 0.01),
#     
#     # Nutrient isolation index (nutrients trapped below pycnocline)
    nutrient_isolation = delta_nitrate_5_30 * mean_N2,
    # High = lots of nutrients below + strong stratification = trapped nutrients
#     
#     # Nutrient depletion at surface
    nitrate_depletion = nitrate_30m - nitrate_5m,  # How much has been consumed?
    
    n_casts = first(n_casts),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ctd_daily_layers <- ctd_daily_layers %>% 
  left_join(weather_join)
```

```{r}
write.csv(ctd_daily_layers, here("outputs", "enviro_2025-12-19.csv"))
```
